scope: Actual notification components compiled in an isolated Next fixture; mocked auth and HTTP boundaries, not a production qualification.

runtime.custom_browser_note: No sparticuz151 version published; 152.0.0 was the closest available. Binary extracted to a persistent workspace path and its version checked.

malformed inbox and acknowledgement payloads do not create a false success
failed preferences GET has no editable defaults and retry recovers
unsaved defaults become persisted only after save and survive reload

save sends only changed fields and the expected account header
a pending save cannot display its success in another account

unconfirmed preference response cannot display saved status
lost save response requires reconfirmation even after reverting to the old value

HTTP 409 removes stale editable preferences and asks to reload the session
keyboard, escape focus, light theme and viewport remain usable

observed_and_resolved: Initial signed-out test locator also matched Next route announcer; scoped to preferences region.
An unverified /tmp/chromium produced intermittent page crashes. Its version cannot be inferred from the installed package.
Initial isolated-browser harness attempted to start tracing twice; removed duplicate tracing and always close browser in finally. One interrupted run exited137; no product PASS claimed from it.
Default npm cache on /home/agent was full; separate workspace cache used for browser install. Next test server now starts directly via Node.
Low visibility of off toggles in the light theme was corrected in the product CSS module; final rendered contrast verified.
